description: Cameras for the Jenga perception scripts besides the work cell's wrist D415. A camera is described by what any RGB-D camera has: image size, pinhole intrinsics in pixels, the metres one depth count stands for, and its pose in the cell's world frame. Nothing here is part of the ur5e-workcell pack or of lab_hardware.json; a camera listed here is used only when enabled, by this file or by --enable-camera.
frame: world_from_camera is 4 x 4, translation in the last column, for the camera's optical frame: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward. Depth is distance along +Z, aligned to the colour image.

tripod.what: Any RGB-D camera on a tripod beside the table at table level, seeing the table, the tower and the robot. Not an Intel model in particular: the numbers below are an example, not a product's.
tripod.placed: Example for the rescan task's tower at (0.30, -0.42): 40 mm beyond the table's far edge, 0.20 m above the table top, 0.59 m from the tower, seeing its far faces, which the wrist camera cannot reach.
tripod.calibration: Nominal, not calibrated. A real camera's world_from_camera has to be measured: see docs/SAM3.md, 'A second camera and its calibration'.
